ModMetadata.Name: Fast Vent
ModMetadata.Author: tasermonkey
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Fast Vent[/h1] This is a Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
I have made enough airlocks now. So I wanted something that can make the 1x1x1 airlock I make all the time fast, so that I don't need patience. So these two vents allows us to make the same setup as before, just replace the original Active Vent and passive vent with these two new vents.
[b]What this mod adds[/b] [list] [*] The [b]Fast Vent[/b]: an Active Vent that moves gas several times faster, inward and outward. It looks and works like the Active Vent: same modes, pressure settings and power draw. In a room bigger than one grid, it also pulls from and fills the cells open to it, like the large Powered Vent. [*] The [b]Pressure Relief Vent[/b]: a Passive Vent that only lets gas out of its pipe above 5 MPa, and then only the gas above 5 MPa, so the pipe is held at 5 MPa. Gas from the room flows into the pipe as through a Passive Vent. It holds as much gas as an in-line Small Tank. [*] Their kits, printed in the Hydraulic Pipe Bender for the same materials as the vanilla vents' kits. [/list]
[b]The Fast Vent's multiplier[/b] The vent's [b]Setting[/b] is how many times faster it is: 1 to 20, 5 when built. Set it with a Logic Writer or a chip ([i]s d0 Setting 10[/i]). Its tooltip shows the current multiplier.
In multiplayer every player needs the mod.
